hints.title: Prefix Sum Requirement
hints.text: To form k groups of sizes 1, 2, ..., k, you need a total count of at least k * (k + 1) / 2 items.

hints.title: Sorted Processing
hints.text: Process elements in ascending order so smaller limits are consumed first without constraining larger groupings.

hints.title: Threshold Extension
hints.text: Accumulate limits and increment the target group count whenever the cumulative total meets the required triangular number.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sort limits in ascending order and compare cumulative counts against triangular numbers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Directly placing items into groups creates combinatorial bin-packing bottlenecks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n log n) time dominated by sorting and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use triangular number prefix checks over sorted counts to guarantee feasibility.
